title: Detailed spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drop shadow / spin blur underneath -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#1a1a3a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='18' ry='3' fill='#2a2a5a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- spin motion lines around the top -->
  <path d='M15 60 Q10 55 15 50' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M85 60 Q90 55 85 50' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M20 70 Q14 67 18 62' stroke='#44aaff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M80 70 Q86 67 82 62' stroke='#44aaff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- handle / stem at top -->
  <rect x='46' y='10' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <rect x='47' y='11' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#ffcc66' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- top knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='5' fill='#ff8833'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#ffdd88'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='7.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- upper body — upper cone/cap -->
  <path d='M42 24 L50 24 L58 24 L62 34 L38 34 Z' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <path d='M42 24 L50 24 L58 24 L60 30 L40 30 Z' fill='#ff6666'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='34' x2='62' y2='34' stroke='#ffaa66' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- upper body stripes -->
  <path d='M40 28 L60 28' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M39 31 L61 31' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- middle band — wide spinning disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='16' ry='4' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='14' ry='3' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <!-- colored segments on disc -->
  <path d='M36 36 A14 3 0 0 1 50 33' stroke='#ff3366' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 33 A14 3 0 0 1 64 36' stroke='#33ccff' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M64 36 A14 3 0 0 1 50 39' stroke='#66ff66' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 39 A14 3 0 0 1 36 36' stroke='#ff66ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- lower cone body -->
  <path d='M38 38 L62 38 L56 62 L44 62 Z' fill='#3399ff'/>
  <path d='M38 38 L62 38 L58 50 L42 50 Z' fill='#55bbff'/>

  <!-- lower body stripes / rings -->
  <path d='M40 42 L60 42' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M41 47 L59 47' stroke='#ff6666' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <path d='M43 53 L57 53' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M44 58 L56 58' stroke='#ffaa33' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- lower tip / point -->
  <path d='M44 62 L56 62 L50 78 Z' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <path d='M45 62 L50 62 L50 75 Z' fill='#ffcc66'/>

  <!-- metal tip -->
  <path d='M48 78 L52 78 L50 84 Z' fill='#ccccdd'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='1.8' fill='#eeeeff'/>

  <!-- highlight shine on body -->
  <path d='M43 40 L44 56' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43.5 27 L44.5 32' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- sparkle effects -->
  <g fill='#ffffaa'>
    <path d='M72 28 L73.5 25 L75 28 L73.5 31 Z'/>
    <path d='M26 45 L27 42.5 L28 45 L27 47.5 Z'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='48' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
